conditions.wake: sim event wake (entities.js: a `sleeps` kind wakes when Jo comes within its wake range; L17's `asleep` cadets only by the plane's wake or a pea)
conditions.telegraph: sim: e.stage turned 'telegraph' (wasp.js: Jo >= 2 u below and within 7 u across, or the practice point / the specimen's re-lock) - the game indexes the clip by e.st and draws the pink line
conditions.dive: sim: e.stage turned 'dive' (TELEGRAPH 0.6 s; RE_TELEGRAPH 0.4 s) - the game turns the quad along e.dir
conditions.stick: sim: e.stage turned 'stuck' (the dive hit a solid or one-way surface; STUCK 1.2 s, 1.6 s the specimen, HONEY_STUCK in honey)
conditions.relock: sim: the specimen's double dive - e.stage back to 'telegraph' mid-dive
conditions.pull_up: sim: e.stage turned 'return' (OPEN_AIR 10 u of dive without a hit, or the stuck time is over)
conditions.home: sim: e.stage turned 'hover' (back at its post; COOLDOWN 1.0 s)
conditions.defeat: sim event defeat (combat.defeat: a stomp while stuck, a pea, a pound, a plough, a punt) - e.state = 'dazed'
conditions.daze_over: e.state turned 'scurry' (DAZE_TIME 0.5 s after the defeat)
conditions.respawn: the entity is back after a level reset (checkpoint / retry)
